bizno.status.idle: A valid checksum does not mean the number is registered — that needs a lookup at Korea's National Tax Service.
bizno.status.bizOk: The format checks out. Whether it is actually registered needs a National Tax Service lookup.
bizno.status.bizBad: The last digit does not match the checksum — most likely a typo.
bizno.status.corpBad: The last digit does not match the checksum.
bizno.status.length: A business number has 10 digits; a corporate registration number has 13.
bizno.kind.nonprofit: Non-profit corporation, head or branch office
